headline: Nvidia creates chip export control committee after concerns over the Huang case
summary: Nvidia created a board-level committee on national security and export controls. The move follows scrutiny of its China business after CEO Jensen Huang resigned over extramarital relationships.
why: Nvidia is the leading supplier of AI accelerator chips, so export compliance rules for China directly affect its revenue exposure and regulatory risk.

impacts.name: Nvidia
impacts.why: The company created a new board committee to oversee export controls and national security issues.
